claim: Les Bateliers de Cassis (GIE) run boat tours at five tiers: 3 calanques (1h, €21), 5 calanques (1h20, €25), 8 calanques (1h50, €29), 9 calanques (2h20, €33), and a 3-calanques-plus-swim-stop (2h, €40).
quote: 3 calanques (1:00h) - €21.00; 5 calanques (1:20h) - €25.00; 8 calanques (1:50h) - €29.00; 9 calanques (2h20) - €33.00; 3 calanques + relaxation stop (2:00h) - €40.00

claim: Standard Bateliers cruises view the cliffs and calanques from the water and do not stop or disembark; only the dedicated relaxation-stop tour includes a swim and is reserved for people who can swim.
quote: The '3 calanques + relaxation stop' tour includes a swimming component and states it is 'reserved for people who know how to swim.'

claim: LOKAYAK, 20m from Grande Mer beach, rents single kayaks in high season (Jun 1-Sep 30) at €30/2h up to €50/6h, two-seaters €45-€85, three-seaters €60-€100; low-season prices are €5 lower; renters must swim 25m unaided and no children under 6.
quote: Single Kayak: 2h €30, 6h €50; Two-Seater: 2h €45, 6h €85; Three-Seater: 2h €60, 6h €100. Low Season prices are €5 lower. Swimmers must complete 25 meters without any assistance; No children under 6 permitted

claim: Destination Calanque offers guided kayak tours from Cassis priced around €47.70 (afternoon), €58.30 (morning) and €74.20 (full day) per person, typically 3 hours, with no children under 12.
quote: guided kayak tours with prices ranging from €47.70 per person for afternoon slots, €58.30 per person for morning slots, and €74.20 per person for full-day tours, with booking fees included

claim: Cassis tourist office lists sea options including soft-propulsion/hybrid eco-labelled boat trips, kayak and paddle (self-guided or guided), snorkelling, and licence-free electric boats; the bay is sheltered by Cap Canaille giving calm, clear water but visitors should check weather, webcams and Calanques access regulations.
quote: Electric boats without a licence for a slow ride at sea... Cap Canaille, the highest maritime cliff in Europe... calm seas, crystal-clear waters... Access regulations: Calanques and Massifs

claim: Licence-free boat rental from Cassis (SamBoat, Click&Boat, JCF Boat, LocBateau) starts around €50/day for small boats up to several hundred euros; small unlicensed boats hold up to 8 people, max 400kg load, and fuel runs about €30/full day, €15/half day paid in cash.
quote: Boats without a license in Cassis start from 372€ per day... some rentals offer boats starting from 50€/day... fuel costs 30€ for a full day and 15€ for a half day... maximum of 8 people and have a maximum load of 400kg

claim: LocBateau rents boats with or without licence by the hour, half-day or full day; unlicensed boats carry up to 8 and licensed boats 8-11, and most of their fleet is authorised to navigate inside the Calanques National Park.
quote: Boats without license: up to 8 people; Boats with license: 8-11 people capacity... most of our boats are authorised to navigate in the Calanques National Park
